name: Zur the Enchanter
description: An enchanter who says the Balduvians' magic is potent and primal.

timeline.summary: Zur the Enchanter declares he and his followers are Kjeldorans no more.

citation.text: Zuran Enchanter (Ice Age, 1995), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Gustha Ebbasdotter defeats Zur, who boasted he would eat her soul.
timeline.quote: He boasted that he would eat my soul—but all he ate were his words."

citation.text: Counterspell (Ice Age, 1995), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Zur the Enchanter declares he will sacrifice anything for eternal life.
timeline.quote: "I will go to any length to achieve my goal. Eternal life is worth any sacrifice."

citation.text: Zuran Orb (Pro Tour Collector Set, 1996), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.
